output.summary: The quota is the main driver. Genuine first-contact demand rose only 4%, and Payroll adds a modest ~380 first-contact tickets a month. The growth is in agent-created split children (240 to 3,710) and duplicates (410 to 2,770), and reopens rose from 6% to 23%. Agents pick quick wins and skip complex tickets. The unquota'd Billing pod stayed flat. Headcount and hours are unchanged, so the effort and capacity hypotheses fail. The reopen rise is real (the trigger is unchanged), and Team C's reopen rate fell once it stopped counting reopened closes. Engineering bugs probably contribute to aged complex tickets but are unclassified. Suspend the quota and use quality measures. Classify the aged tickets. Do not raise the quota or hire yet.
